definitions.population: AR1–AR6 reference occurrences linked through chapters.report_id; all report units included in the primary cohort.
definitions.paper_cohort: Set of non-null paper_id values cited by at least one extracted occurrence in each report. Repeated occurrences count once.
definitions.vintage: New to AR6 means absent from the AR5 paper-ID cohort, not newly published. Through 2013 versus after 2013 is a descriptive year split, not a claim about source-specific search cutoffs.
definitions.citation_age: Occurrence-weighted source publication year minus linked paper.year_best; sources joined through chapter.source_id. Source year is used if exactly one four-digit year is present, otherwise the report fallback. Include ages 0–60; exclusions are counted separately.
definitions.identity_quality: Paper IDs and enriched metadata can merge unrelated references. Matched occurrence status is a quality-conditioned subset, not a guarantee of correct identity. Future preferred years and parsed/preferred-year mismatches are candidates for review, not automatic corrections.
definitions.quartiles: statistics.quantiles(method='exclusive'); the same rule as the toolkit analytics engine.
definitions.journal: Casefold and collapsed whitespace; no abbreviation expansion or title-family merger. Journal title is an outlet descriptor, not a formal discipline assignment.
definitions.journal_hhi: Sum of squared distinct-paper shares over named journal titles; missing journals excluded and reported separately. Alternative HHI includes missing as one category.

sensitivities.matched_occurrences_only: Paper IDs with at least one matched_doi or matched_title occurrence in the report.
sensitivities.verified_metadata_only: Paper verification_status is wos_matched or doi_verified.
sensitivities.doi_verified_only: Paper verification_status is doi_verified (a workflow-status subset, excluding wos_matched).
sensitivities.chronological_coherence: Paper IDs with at least one occurrence whose valid preferred publication year does not exceed its source year; missing preferred years are excluded.
sensitivities.matched_chronological_coherence: Chronologically coherent occurrences restricted to matched_doi or matched_title.
sensitivities.main_wg_only: Only occurrences in chapters with working-group labels exactly WG1, WG2 or WG3; excludes SYR and combined/other units.

definitions.coverage_units: Catalogue units include front matter and annexes; a unit without occurrences does not by itself establish extraction failure or missing scientific content.
definitions.inference: Descriptive enumeration of the extracted corpus; no hypothesis tests or uncertainty intervals that imply probability sampling.

sql:
SELECT r.occurrence_id, c.report_id, wg.wg_label, r.chapter_id, r.paper_id,
       r.match_status, r.parsed_year, r.raw_reference, p.doi_norm, p.verification_status, p.year_best,
       p.journal_best, p.title_best, p.n_reports, s.publication_year AS source_year,
       r.source_id, c.source_id AS chapter_source_id
FROM references_occurrence r
JOIN chapters c ON c.chapter_id = r.chapter_id
LEFT JOIN working_groups wg ON wg.wg_id = c.wg_id
LEFT JOIN papers p ON p.paper_id = r.paper_id
LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.source_id = c.source_id
WHERE c.report_id IN ('AR1','AR2','AR3','AR4','AR5','AR6')
ORDER BY c.report_id, r.occurrence_id
